author: xkcd's What If?
description:
Get a copy of What If? 2 and Randall’s other books at: https://xkcd.com/books
More serious answers to absurd questions at: https://what-if.xkcd.com/

This question comes from Evin, who asks: what if you exploded a nuclear bomb (say, the Tsar Bomba) at the bottom of the Mariana Trench?
The answer is: surprisingly little, unless you get a cat involved.
